BiblicalUsage: In Hebrew, saʻărâh means hairiness. It stands in 1 Kings 1:52, "…he will shew himself a worthy man, there…", and in 1 Samuel 14:45, "…Jonathan die, who hath wrought this great salvation…".
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that saʻărâh counts, because God put it in his book.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
